name: DDIM Sampling with Classifier-Free Guidance
definition: Iteratively denoises latent variables using the DDIM scheduler and classifier-free guidance to generate images or refine existing ones.
summary: DDIM Sampling with Classifier-Free Guidance is a deterministic reverse diffusion process that generates latent representations by iteratively denoising noise, differing from DDPM by using deterministic transitions to enable fewer sampling iterations.
